thread:
Maria (Support): Heads up — trial account BrightAtlas is blocked. After SSO provisioning their embed calls are timing out (lots of 504s). Ticket T-9876. Escalating to CS for an urgent handoff; renewal decision in ~10 days, customer running validation tests today.
Kelly (CS): Ack. Quick ask: short summary of impact, any mitigation attempted, and customer contact? We’ll need a one-paragraph customer message and an internal comms plan.
Maria (Support): Impact: embed success rate ~12% over last 2hrs, previously ~98%. Error seen in logs: "POST /v1/embeds -> 504 gateway timeout: KV cache miss -> fallback loop". Mitigations tried: restarted inference pool (no change), increased request timeout (no change). Contact: Anne Park (anne@brightatlas.com), timezone PST. Customer demo scheduled tomorrow, needs embed results.
Jamal (Solutions): Possible quick mitigation: route BrightAtlas to dedicated pool + pin to older model variant (less memory pressure). Proposed route config (temporary):
```
route_policy:
  match: tenant_id=brightatlas
  prefer: dedicated-pool-7
  fallback_model: rwd-llm-7b-q4f
```
This avoids KV eviction loops on shared pools. I can push the route if ops approves. Also suggest enabling prefix KV caching for their common queries.
Sam (Ops Lead): I can spin up a short-lived burst pool for them (2h) — will need approval to use reserved capacity. If approved, I’ll attach them to pool-7 and run a health smoke test. Ping me when you want me to schedule. bridge-bot: created incident bridge https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-9821 (auto). Use that for the 2pm sync.
Kelly (CS): Maria — please draft the customer-facing message (1-2 sentences + ETA) and post here. I’ll own the outreach once Ops confirms mitigation window. Also thumbs up if we should propose a temporary credit given disruption.
Maria (Support): Draft to customer (for Kelly to send): "Hi Anne — we’re seeing intermittent timeouts from our embeddings service after your SSO provisioning. We’ve prioritized this and will apply a mitigation (route to a dedicated pool) within the next 2 hours. Expect an update by 14:00 PST. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll follow up with next steps and a postmortem." :pray:
Kelly (CS): Nice. Tweak: add "cc: cs@redwood.com" and offer 2-hour mitigation and a 1:1 to review results after. Final message I’ll send after Ops confirms. :thumbsup:
Sam (Ops Lead): Approved. Spinning up dedicated-pool-7 now, allocating 2 GPUs. Running smoke test — run this from support console to validate once I say go:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"test embed"}' | jq '.status'
```
Expect status = "ok" and ~<100ms median token latency. I’ll post when pool is up.
bridge-bot: dedicated-pool-7 provisioned (allocated 2xA10G) — baseline tests passed.
Maria (Support): Tested against pool-7 — embed call returns ok, latency ~120ms, success rate 100% for 10/10 samples. Sending Kelly the draft to go out now. Also capturing logs and request IDs for later RCA.
Kelly (CS): Sending message to Anne now, cc cs@redwood.com. Scheduling 14:00 PST sync on the bridge. Proposed internal comms: 1) notify AE (cc), 2) ops mitigation window 2h, 3) postmortem repo link and follow-up within 48h. Any objections? If none, I’ll file the comms plan and mark as Priority: High.
Jamal (Solutions): No objections. Recommend adding a longer-term ask: enable model variant pinning for all trial tenants to avoid noisy neighbor issues during onboarding.
Kelly (CS): Good call — adding that to action items. Closing note: capture any customer feedback from the sync and paste here so CS can include in renewal risk assessment. Thanks team :heart:
